text.en:
The articles specifically listed in "Annex A' hereof, as classified
under Section 104 of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978, as amended, shall be
subject to the rates of import duty in accordance with the schedule indicated
opposite each article.

The nomenclature and the rates of import duty on tariff headings
not enumerated and those listed but represented by the symbol "XXX" shall remain
in force and effect.

Upon the effectivity of this Executive Order, the articles
specifically listed in the aforesaid "Annex A" which are entered in or withdrawn from
warehouses in the Philippines for consumption shall be levied the rates of duty
herein prescribed.

All other Presidential issuances, administrative rules and
regulations, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are
hereby revoked or modified accordingly.
PEE Holagan l 22396

This Executive Order shall take effect 01 January 2001 following
its complete publication in two (2) newspapers of general circulation in the
Philippines.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3 ye day of JANUARY in the year of
our Lord Two Thousand. One.
By the President.
RAMON B. CARDENAS
Acting Executive Secretary
